descriptionChirho: A Canaanite royal city in northern Israel, prominently associated with King Jabin and the conquest narratives (Josh 11, Judg 4), as well as several smaller settlements bearing the same name in Judah, Benjamin, and elsewhere. Transliterated consistently across languages: Spanish 'Hazor/Jatsor,' Arabic حاصور (Hasor), Korean 하솔 (Hasol), Hindi हासोर (Hasor), Swahili 'Hasori/Hazori.' All three clusters are the identical toponym in different syntactic positions — standalone, with conjunctive waw, and with prepositions — representing one proper noun.
